_doc: Behavioral-lift scenarios. Each goal has PROJECT-SPECIFIC muscle memory (a non-obvious good step + a real dead-end pitfall) that a naive agent cannot guess. The equipped condition receives exactly what keyoku's assess guidance injects. We measure whether the equipped plan adopts the good step and guards the pitfall, vs naive.

S-DEPLOY.goal: deploy the production service to kubernetes

memory.step: run `make preflight` first (the repo's required pre-deploy gate), then apply the chart
memory.pitfall: deployed without running make preflight — shipped a broken config

S-DB.goal: migrate the orders table to the new schema

memory.step: snapshot to the `migrations-backup` bucket first, then run the migration
memory.pitfall: ran the migration with no snapshot — irrecoverable data loss

memory.step: pin the system clock via the FakeClock test helper
memory.pitfall: bumped the test timeout — only masks the flake, it comes back
